evidence_plan.requirement: Identify the baselines used in the study

payload.reason: The evidence provides information about the models and tasks used, which can be interpreted as the baselines for the study.

claims.text: The study used base variants of models for tasks, with results reported for large variants.
The tasks included speculation detection and scope resolution, indicating the baseline tasks evaluated.
The models performed best when trained on the same dataset they were evaluated on, indicating a baseline performance metric.
